dict.string: Tidy Drives reads the names, sizes and dates of files on your drives to catalogue them, and copies the files you plan to move. Your originals are never changed or deleted.
Tidy Drives copies the files you plan into the folder you chose in Documents.
Tidy Drives copies the files you plan into the folder you chose on the Desktop.
Tidy Drives copies the files you plan into the folder you chose in Downloads.
